reference.label: reference map, e.g. the CPU run

candidate.label: map to check, e.g. the MPS run

control.label: a map that must not agree, e.g. the reverse-depth output

facts.title: verify
facts.tagline: check that two ink maps of the same input agree, with a control
facts.not_a_pass: Exit code 3 (`pass-uncontrolled`); `control-not-caught`; a `pass` on float maps with the default tolerance of 2; a `pass` with NaN statistics, which means NaN in both maps at the same pixels; any `pass` read as evidence that a map shows ink.
facts.never: Call two agreeing maps a result about ink; report agreement without its control; drop the control to turn a failing check into exit code 3.
